page.overview:
Who is Bebop?

Bebop is a character appearing in the Teeny Mutant Ninja Turtles series. He and his friend are children in this series, though both are depicted as streetwise thugs.

Bebop is a mutant warthog with small tusks and a purple mohawk. He wears a white shirt with a brown, sleeveless jacket pulled over it, jeans with a hole in one knee, and brown boots.

The Turtles' training session is interrupted by the "Cowabunga Call", an alarm that alerts them to trouble in the city. When they check the monitor, they see Bebop and stealing pizzas. When the Turtles arrive to retrieve the pizzas, Bebop and Rocksteady each take half their "loot" and run. and pursue Bebop, who is having a tough time balancing the stack of pizza boxes. Leo bounds over his head and grabs the pizza boxes from him before tossing them to Donnie. Bebop runs to catch up to Rocksteady, who has managed to hold onto one pizza. The pair cross the road safely, but the Turtles are forced to stop when the crosswalk light indicates they must not cross. As they back away, Bebop and Rocksteady start laughing at the Turtles, but neither see the open manhole behind them. The pair of pizza thieves fall into the sewers and lose their last stolen pizza.

After hearing the Cowabunga Call alarm, the Turtles see on their computer monitor that someone has placed false mustaches all over things in the city. They head to the streets and when they hear laughter, they discover that it is Bebop and Rocksteady who are sticking mustaches on everything.

Also known as: Bebop warthog.
